notes.title: Update released
notes.content:
In this update:
- Lighting rework, it has become more complex but no less scary.
-Updated lore, now learning it is rewarded with an achievement.
-New achievements, get them all, only a few can do it.
-Bug fixes, enjoy improved quality.
-Updated world.
-Reworking the history of game characters.

We thank everyone who purchased the game and invite you to experience the new sensations from the updated version. You can describe all your wishes about innovations in the future in the community. We will always be happy to answer the wishes of the players.
Thank you for your attention.

notes.title: Meet the Terrifying Update
notes.content:
A booming howl in the night forest,
The grinding is chilling,
He will keep the secret of the world,
Sleeping under the ground.

 We are glad to announce the upcoming update. In the coming future, we will give you the opportunity to taste new fruits of secrets and horrors that hide behind every shadow.
 The game will be largely redesigned, you can find out more details with the release of the update.
